   [List of Documents Here]

   L.A. Care Health Plan
   Attn: Executive Suite / Legal Department
   1055 W. 7th Street
   Los Angeles, CA 90017

4. I am familiar with my organization’s practice for the collection and processing of correspondence for mailing. Under that practice, such correspondence is deposited with the U.S. Postal Service on the same day it is placed for collection.

5. I confirm that the address listed above is the current, active corporate headquarters for legal service of process for L.A. Care Health Plan.

I declare under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing is true and correct.

Executed on May 12, 2026, at [City], California.
